title: MAGE: Towards Generalizable Multi-timescale EEG Representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.09928v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) data plays an important role in understanding human brain activity, with various major applications. While current approaches, which largely build on EEG foundation models, have demonstrated strong performance across datasets and tasks, they typically rely on a fixed temporal scale. This design choice limits their ability to capture characteristics of neural dynamic behavior, often spanning across multiple timescales, which are naturally captured in EEG recordings. To address this limitation, we propose MAGE (\textbf{Multi-timescale Adaptive Generalization for EEG}), a foundation model that dynamically adapts to capture and integrate information across different timescales. translated_title: MAGE：迈向可泛化的多时间尺度脑电表征
translated_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）数据在理解人类大脑活动方面发挥着重要作用，并具有多种重要应用。尽管当前主要基于脑电基础模型的方法在多个数据集和任务上展现出强大的性能，但它们通常依赖于固定的时间尺度。这种设计选择限制了其捕捉神经动态行为特征的能力，而这些特征往往跨越多个时间尺度，并被自然地记录在脑电信号中。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了MAGE（Multi-timescale Adaptive Generalization for EEG，脑电多时间尺度自适应泛化模型），一个能够动态适应以捕捉并整合不同时间尺度信息的基础模型。具体而言，MAGE结合了两个关键机制：(i) 一种新颖的多时间尺度注意力机制，能够学习跨越多个时间尺度的表征；(ii) 一个可训练的聚合模块，能够动态地识别……（摘要此处截断）
tldr: 提出了MAGE脑电基础模型，通过新颖的多时间尺度注意力机制和可训练的动态聚合模块，自适应地捕捉并整合脑电信号中跨越多个时间尺度的神经动态信息，突破了现有模型固定时间尺度的局限。
en_tdlr: MAGE is an EEG foundation model that dynamically captures and integrates information across multiple temporal scales via a novel multi-timescale attention mechanism and a trainable aggregation module, overcoming the fixed-timescale limitation of existing EEG foundation models.
